findings.location: test-host-check.sh docker-unreachable case (blind fixture, grep -Eiq docker)
findings.obligation: B7 refusal: when Docker cannot be asked, say so and do not call host clean (P5)
findings.observation: Non-blocking. The case passes on any output containing the word docker, e.g. a finding HOW text such as docker rmi, so a check that swallows the failure but still prints a docker remedy line and exits 1 would pass; the stand-in docker_down also leaves the clean path untested.
findings.remediation: Optionally require a line matching (cannot|could not|unable|not reach|failed).*docker or docker.*(cannot|could not|unreachable|not running) in the blind output.

findings.location: test-host-check.sh stand-in systemctl is-active/is-enabled; runner fixture
findings.obligation: Leftover host runner service found (P5), without coupling to one implementation
findings.observation: Non-blocking. is-active/is-enabled match exact unit names only (real is-active accepts globs); the runner leftover fixture is always enabled and active, so an installed but disabled or stopped host runner unit is untested.
findings.remediation: Optionally let is-active glob like list-units, and add a runner variant that is disabled or inactive if the design counts it a leftover.
